retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast, low-key portrait of two men against a pure black background with warm, dramatic lighting that emphasizes facial features and urban headwear.
excludeWhen: bright or colorful backgrounds are required
soft or even lighting is requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A tight, medium-close-up shot of two men positioned side-by-side, emerging from a deep black void. The lighting is directional and warm, creating sharp highlights on the skin and clothing while leaving the rest of the frame in total darkness. One subject wears a light-colored hoodie and cap, while the other wears a dark beanie and jacket, creating a subtle contrast in texture and value.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject faces emerging from a solid black void
Warm, amber-toned highlights against cool, dark shadows
Tight framing focusing on facial expressions and headwear
Slightly staggered positioning of the two subjects for depth
coreInvariants: Sharp focus on the eyes and facial hair

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two subjects occupy the center horizontal band, scaled to fill approximately 60% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The eyes of the subjects, particularly the one on the right, which are positioned at the upper third line.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The viewer's eye moves from the bright hoodie on the left to the more shadowed face on the right, following the horizontal alignment of the eyes.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive negative space surrounds the subjects on all sides, focusing all attention on the central figures.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep black background provides the primary canvas.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm amber and golden highlights on the skin and clothing.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Neutral whites and greys in the hoodie and jacket collar.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the bright highlights and the black background; mid-range saturation in the skin tones.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid cool blues or greens in the lighting

letterConstructionRules: Varying line weights with sharp terminals
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are merged into a single cohesive mark or monogram
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single stylized mark to maintain focus on the portrait photography.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the urban hip-hop aesthetic of the portrait.
Provides a clean, professional branding look.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast portrait of two men with urban headwear (hoodie and beanie) against a solid black background. Use warm, directional lighting to create a chiaroscuro effect, highlighting facial features and textures of the clothing while keeping the background completely dark.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a small, white, stylized script logo or monogram in the bottom right corner, ensuring it is clean and does not distract from the main portrait.

verificationChecks: Is the lighting warm and directional?
Are the subjects' eyes in sharp focus?
Is the logo small and placed in the bottom right?

adjustableVariables: Specific headwear styles (e.g., snapback vs. beanie)

mustAchieve: Clean separation between subject and black background

postGenerationChecks: Ensure no 'halos' around the subjects against the black background
Check that the warm light doesn't blow out skin details
Verify the logo is legible but unobtrusive
Confirm the composition feels balanced despite the negative space
recipe.reuseFormula: Urban Portrait = (Two Subjects + Streetwear) * (Chiaroscuro Lighting + Black Background) + (Minimalist Corner Branding)
